# Stéphane Rathgeber

> Tech Lead Symfony. A PHP developer since 2008 and a Symfony developer since version 1.3, I have worked with large companies such as Renault, Accor, My Money Bank, AXA, Cardif and Maif. I have mentored dozens of developers and helped them grow their skills. I can build an application from scratch or take over an existing one and keep it evolving. I can also set up continuous deployment.

- Professional experience since 2008 (18 years)
- Current engagements: Fractional CTO / Symfony Developer at France Care; Symfony Developer / Tech Lead at GDB Consulting
- Core skills: PHP, HTML, Symfony, API Platform, REST, API, Git
- Sectors: Travel, Healthcare, Energy, Web intelligence, Big Data, Defense, E-commerce, Retail media, Insurance, savings, E-signature, SaaS for non-profits, Life insurance, Automotive, consumer credit
- Languages of this site: French (primary) and English
